title: Lispico installed-pack snapshot
description: Version-1 inert snapshot of the packs a Lispico installation has materialized. The schema fixes only the closed shape of the document: which packs exist, which entries each selected, and the problems recorded while reading them. Sorting, digest recomputation, symlink- and race-safe reads, pack membership decisions, and live freshness checks are future typed-consumer work, not schema guarantees. The document carries no fingerprint of its own: a project `expected_fingerprint` pins these raw JSON bytes, and the consumer is what hashes them.

source_revision.description: Source revision the snapshot was taken at.

selection_generation.description: Layer-selection generation the snapshot was produced under.

packs.description: Installed packs. An empty set is valid for a v2-generation installation with no packs.

entries.description: Files selected from installed packs, in no guaranteed order.

problems.description: Problems recorded while reading the packs; presence never invalidates the snapshot.

digest.description: Opaque pack digest; only equality is defined.

pack.description: Name of the pack the entry was selected from.

status.description: Whether the file content could be read when the snapshot was taken.

source.description: Pack-relative source path. Required for readable entries, forbidden for unreadable ones.

source_digest.description: Prefixed lowercase SHA-256 digest (`sha256:…`) of the read content. Required for readable entries, forbidden for unreadable ones.

pack.description: Pack the problem belongs to, when known.

key.description: Pack-relative entry the problem belongs to, when known.

relative_path.description: Canonical relative path: `/` separators, no leading slash, no drive letter, no backslash, and no empty, `.`, or `..` segments.
